sentences.text: Put corn in a hot pan.
Wait one minute.
Then it happens.
Pop. Pop. Pop pop pop.
A small hard seed becomes a white cloud.
sentences.translationRu: Маленькое твёрдое зерно становится белым облачком.

sentences.text: It is ten times bigger than before.
sentences.translationRu: Оно в десять раз больше, чем было.

sentences.text: Why does this happen?
And why only with this kind of corn?
sentences.translationRu: И почему только с этой кукурузой?

sentences.text: You cannot pop rice.
You cannot pop a bean.
You cannot pop normal corn.
The answer is the skin.
Popcorn has a very hard skin.
sentences.translationRu: У попкорновой кукурузы очень твёрдая оболочка.

sentences.text: Much harder than other seeds.
sentences.translationRu: Намного твёрже, чем у других семян.

sentences.text: Water cannot get out through it.
sentences.translationRu: Вода через неё выйти не может.

sentences.text: And there is water inside.
Not much. About one drop.
Now you make it hot.
The water wants to become steam.
Steam needs a lot of room.
But the skin does not let it out.
So the pressure goes up.
And up, and up.
Inside the seed there is also starch.
sentences.translationRu: Внутри зерна есть ещё и крахмал.

sentences.text: Hot wet starch becomes soft.
Like very thick glue.
At about one hundred and eighty degrees
the skin finally breaks.
Everything happens at once.
The steam escapes.
The soft starch is pushed out with it.
sentences.translationRu: Мягкий крахмал выносит наружу вместе с ним.

sentences.text: It fills with bubbles, like bread.
And then it meets the cold air.
It becomes hard in less than a second.
sentences.translationRu: И твердеет меньше чем за секунду.

sentences.text: That is your piece of popcorn.
It is starch, frozen while it was exploding.
sentences.translationRu: Это крахмал, застывший прямо во время взрыва.

sentences.text: Now you know the unpopped ones.
They are at the bottom of every bowl.
sentences.translationRu: Они лежат на дне каждой миски.

sentences.text: Their skin had a small hole.
sentences.translationRu: У них в оболочке была дырочка.

sentences.text: Or they were too dry.
The steam left quietly.
So there was no pressure.
And with no pressure, there is no pop.
sentences.translationRu: А без давления нет и хлопка.

title: Why old books smell the way they do

sentences.text: Open an old book and smell it.
Almost everybody does this.
And almost everybody likes it.
Sweet, a little like vanilla.
A little like grass, a little like wood.
sentences.translationRu: Немного на траву, немного на дерево.

sentences.text: New books smell completely different.
Sharper. More like a chemical.
There is a reason for both smells.
And the reason is a little sad.
The smell is the book breaking down.
Paper is made from wood.
Wood has long chains inside it.
Over many years the chains break.
They break into small pieces.
Some of those pieces float into the air.
sentences.translationRu: Часть этих кусочков улетает в воздух.

sentences.text: Your nose catches them.
So the smell you love
is the book slowly falling apart.
Each piece has its own smell.
One of them smells of vanilla.
It is the same chemical.
Another smells of almonds.
Another smells of cut grass.
Together they make that one smell.
sentences.translationRu: Вместе они и дают тот самый запах.

sentences.text: The one you cannot describe.
Old paper also has acid in it.
sentences.translationRu: В старой бумаге есть ещё и кислота.

sentences.text: For about a hundred years
paper was made in an acid way.
It was cheaper and faster.
Nobody thought about the future.
That paper turns brown at the edges.
Then it turns brown everywhere.
Then it breaks when you touch it.
Libraries have a name for these years.
sentences.translationRu: У библиотек есть название для тех лет.

sentences.text: They call it the brittle century.
Millions of books are dying quietly.
Scientists now use the smell as a tool.
sentences.translationRu: Учёные теперь используют запах как инструмент.

sentences.text: They can test the air around a book.
And learn how damaged it is inside.
sentences.translationRu: И узнают, насколько она разрушена внутри.

sentences.text: Without opening it at all.
The book tells them how it feels.
sentences.translationRu: Книга сама сообщает, как она себя чувствует.

sentences.text: By smelling wonderful.

title: The man who kept a list of his own broken bones

sentences.text: Most actors do not do their own stunts.
sentences.translationRu: Большинство актёров не делают свои трюки.

sentences.text: There is a good reason for that.
sentences.translationRu: И на то есть веская причина.

sentences.text: A stunt performer is a trained athlete.
An actor is not.
And an injured actor stops the whole film.
sentences.translationRu: А травмированный актёр останавливает весь фильм.

sentences.text: Insurance companies are very clear about this.
sentences.translationRu: Страховые компании высказываются об этом очень ясно.

sentences.text: Jackie Chan ignored all of it.
For decades he did the stunts himself.
And he was hurt constantly.
A skull fracture. A broken nose, several times.
sentences.translationRu: Перелом черепа. Сломанный нос, и не раз.

sentences.text: Fingers, ankles, ribs, cheekbone.
He has spoken about it openly for years.
sentences.translationRu: Он годами открыто об этом рассказывал.

sentences.text: For a long time no company would insure him.
sentences.translationRu: Долгое время его никто не хотел страховать.

sentences.text: What he was doing was not recklessness.
sentences.translationRu: То, что он делал, не было безрассудством.

sentences.text: It was a specific idea about film.
sentences.translationRu: Это была конкретная идея о кино.

sentences.text: A cut hides things.
Cut to a close-up, cut to a wide shot,
sentences.translationRu: Склейка на крупный план, склейка на общий —

sentences.text: and the audience does not know what happened.
sentences.translationRu: и зритель не знает, что произошло.

sentences.text: Maybe the actor did it. Maybe not.
sentences.translationRu: Может, актёр сделал сам. Может, нет.

sentences.text: His films answer that question.
sentences.translationRu: Его фильмы отвечают на этот вопрос.

sentences.text: The camera holds the shot.
You see the whole body, from head to feet.
sentences.translationRu: Видно тело целиком, с головы до ног.

sentences.text: You see the fall land.
There is nowhere for a double to hide.
His fight scenes are built like dances.
Long takes. Clear space. Real distance.
sentences.translationRu: Длинные планы. Понятное пространство. Настоящая дистанция.

sentences.text: You always know where everyone is.
Which sounds obvious and is rare.
Many modern fights do the opposite.
Very short cuts. Shaking camera.
You feel something without seeing anything.
sentences.translationRu: Ты что-то чувствуешь, ничего не видя.

sentences.text: That style is often a solution to a problem.
The problem being that nobody can really fight.
sentences.translationRu: Проблему в том, что драться толком никто не умеет.

sentences.text: Then there are the endings of his films.
He shows the mistakes over the credits.
sentences.translationRu: На титрах он показывает неудачные дубли.

sentences.text: The falls that went wrong.
The ambulance. The crew running in.
Almost nobody else does this.
sentences.translationRu: Так почти никто больше не делает.

sentences.text: It breaks the illusion completely.
And it replaces it with something else.
Not: look how brave this character is.
But: look what this actually cost.
sentences.translationRu: А «смотри, чего это на самом деле стоило».

title: The gymnast who lost track of the floor

sentences.text: Gymnasts have a word for a specific terror.
sentences.translationRu: У гимнастов есть слово для одного особого ужаса.

sentences.text: They call it the twisties.
The name sounds almost playful.
What it describes is not.
A gymnast in the air is not guessing.
Years of training build something automatic.
The body knows where the floor is.
It knows how much rotation is left.
It prepares to land without being asked.
sentences.translationRu: Оно готовится к приземлению без команды.

sentences.text: The twisties are that system switching off.
sentences.translationRu: The twisties — это отключение той системы.

sentences.text: Mid-air, without warning.
Suddenly the athlete is simply falling.
Upside down, at speed, with no map.
In most sports, losing your nerve is survivable.
sentences.translationRu: В большинстве видов потеря уверенности переживаема.

sentences.text: You play badly and you lose a match.
In gymnastics it is a neck injury.
At the Tokyo Olympics in 2021
sentences.translationRu: На Олимпиаде в Токио в 2021 году

sentences.text: Simone Biles withdrew from event finals.
She was the most decorated gymnast alive.
sentences.translationRu: Она была самой титулованной гимнасткой в мире.

sentences.text: She said she could not find the air.
sentences.translationRu: Она сказала, что не чувствует воздух.

sentences.text: The reaction split immediately.
Some people called it a mental collapse.
Some called it quitting under pressure.
Gymnasts said something much plainer.
They said she would have been carried out.
sentences.translationRu: Они сказали, что её бы унесли.

sentences.text: The argument that followed was not about her.
sentences.translationRu: Спор, который начался потом, был не о ней.

sentences.text: It was about what sport is allowed to cost.
sentences.translationRu: Он был о том, сколько спорту позволено стоить.

sentences.text: Whether an athlete owes the audience a landing.
Whether stopping can ever be the strong choice.
sentences.translationRu: Может ли остановка быть сильным решением.

sentences.text: Those questions were not new.
They had simply never been asked out loud
sentences.translationRu: Просто их никогда не задавали вслух

sentences.text: by somebody at the very top.
She competed again three years later.
sentences.translationRu: Через три года она вернулась в соревнования.

sentences.text: And won, which made the story neat.
sentences.translationRu: И победила — и история стала складной.

sentences.text: Neatness is worth being careful about.
The comeback is not what mattered.
Plenty of athletes never come back.
What mattered was that stopping was survivable.
sentences.translationRu: Дело было в том, что остановка оказалась переживаемой.

sentences.text: That a career could contain it.
Coaches now use the word in training.
sentences.translationRu: Тренеры теперь используют это слово на тренировках.

sentences.text: Which is the whole of the change.
A thing with a name can be reported.
sentences.translationRu: О том, у чего есть имя, можно сообщить.

sentences.text: A thing with no name is just weakness.
sentences.translationRu: То, у чего имени нет, — просто слабость.

sentences.text: Stand on any street in a large city.
sentences.translationRu: Встань на любой улице большого города.

sentences.text: Under your feet there is a second city.
sentences.translationRu: Под ногами у тебя второй город.

sentences.text: It is denser than the one above.
And almost nobody has a complete map of it.
sentences.translationRu: И полной карты его почти ни у кого нет.

sentences.text: Water comes in under pressure.
Waste goes out under gravity.
Those two must never meet.
sentences.translationRu: Эти двое не должны встречаться никогда.

sentences.text: Gas runs in its own line.
Electricity in another.
Telephone copper, then fibre beside it.
Heating pipes in some cities.
Then the tunnels people travel through.
sentences.translationRu: Потом тоннели, по которым ездят люди.

sentences.text: And rivers that were buried a century ago.
All of it in about four metres of soil.
sentences.translationRu: Всё это примерно в четырёх метрах грунта.

sentences.text: The interesting problem is not engineering.
It is memory.
Each of those systems was laid by someone.
At a different time, for a different employer.
sentences.translationRu: В разное время, для разного нанимателя.

sentences.text: Under a different set of rules.
Records were kept on paper.
Companies merged, split and went bankrupt.
Paper moved to a basement and then to nowhere.
sentences.translationRu: Бумага переезжала в подвал, а потом в никуда.

sentences.text: So a crew opening a road is partly guessing.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому бригада, вскрывающая дорогу, отчасти гадает.

sentences.text: Which is why they dig slowly.
And why a gas line gets cut somewhere
sentences.translationRu: И почему где-то режут газовую трубу

sentences.text: almost every day of the year.
Cities have tried to solve this twice.
The first attempt was the utility tunnel.
One large passage carrying everything.
Walk in, see the pipes, fix the pipe.
No digging at all.
It works, and it is very expensive.
So it exists in a handful of districts.
Usually ones rebuilt after a disaster.
Which is the pattern worth noticing.
Good underground infrastructure follows destruction.
sentences.translationRu: Хорошая подземная инфраструктура следует за разрушением.

sentences.text: Because that is the only moment
when nobody is standing on the street.
sentences.translationRu: когда на улице никто не стоит.

sentences.text: The second attempt is the survey.
Radar that reads the ground from a vehicle.
Slowly building the map that was never written.
sentences.translationRu: Он медленно строит карту, которую никогда не писали.

sentences.text: It is tedious and it is working.
Several cities now know what is below them.
sentences.translationRu: Несколько городов теперь знают, что у них внизу.

sentences.text: For the first time since they were built.

title: A mirror does not swap left and right

sentences.text: Stand in front of a mirror and raise your right hand.
sentences.translationRu: Встань перед зеркалом и подними правую руку.

sentences.text: The figure facing you raises its left.
So a mirror reverses left and right.
sentences.translationRu: Значит, зеркало меняет местами лево и право.

sentences.text: Everyone has always said so.
Now ask the obvious follow-up.
Why does it not reverse up and down?
sentences.translationRu: Почему оно не меняет верх и низ?

sentences.text: Your head is still at the top.
Your feet are still on the floor.
A mirror has no way of knowing
which of your axes is which.
It is a flat sheet. It has no opinion.
sentences.translationRu: Это плоский лист. У него нет мнения.

sentences.text: The moment the question is put that way
sentences.translationRu: В ту секунду, когда вопрос поставлен так,

sentences.text: the usual answer stops being an answer.
What a mirror actually reverses is depth.
sentences.translationRu: На самом деле зеркало переворачивает глубину.

sentences.text: The axis running towards it and away.
sentences.translationRu: Ось, идущую к нему и от него.

sentences.text: Front becomes back. Nothing else moves.
sentences.translationRu: Перед становится задом. Остальное не двигается.

sentences.text: Push your nose towards the glass
and the reflected nose comes to meet it.
That is the whole operation.
So where does the left-right story come from?
sentences.translationRu: Откуда же взялась история про лево и право?

sentences.text: From you, not from the mirror.
sentences.translationRu: От тебя, а не от зеркала.

sentences.text: You describe the reflection as a person.
And to describe a person's left and right
sentences.translationRu: А чтобы описать лево и право человека,

sentences.text: you have to imagine turning to face them.
sentences.translationRu: приходится вообразить, что ты к нему поворачиваешься.

sentences.text: You perform that rotation in your head.
sentences.translationRu: Этот разворот ты делаешь в голове.

sentences.text: Around the vertical axis, because you walk.
sentences.translationRu: Вокруг вертикальной оси — потому что ты ходишь.

sentences.text: Rotating around the horizontal one
would mean standing on your head.
The mirror did not swap anything.
You did, silently, while describing it.
sentences.translationRu: Это сделал ты — молча, пока описывал.

sentences.text: There is a test that settles it.
Write a word on a sheet of paper.
Hold it up to the mirror facing the glass.
The letters read backwards, as expected.
sentences.translationRu: Буквы читаются задом наперёд, как и ожидалось.

sentences.text: Now hold the same sheet above your head
sentences.translationRu: Теперь подними тот же лист над головой

sentences.text: and tip it back so the mirror sees it.
sentences.translationRu: и наклони назад, чтобы зеркало его увидело.

sentences.text: The letters are now upside down instead.
Same mirror. Same paper.
sentences.translationRu: То же зеркало. Тот же лист.

sentences.text: The only thing that changed was how you turned it.
sentences.translationRu: Изменилось лишь то, как ты его повернул.

sentences.text: Physicists enjoy this puzzle
because almost nobody gets it wrong for lack of physics.
sentences.translationRu: потому что почти никто не ошибается из-за нехватки физики.

sentences.text: They get it wrong for lack of noticing
sentences.translationRu: Ошибаются из-за того, что не замечают

sentences.text: what they themselves brought to the question.
sentences.translationRu: того, что сами внесли в вопрос.

sentences.text: Which is a fair description of most confusion.
sentences.translationRu: А это неплохое описание большинства путаницы.
